sanskrit: tvam a̍gne̱ dyubhi̱s tvam ā̍śuśu̱kṣaṇi̱s tvam a̱dbhyas tvam aśma̍na̱s pari̍ | tvaṁ vane̍bhya̱s tvam oṣa̍dhībhya̱s tvaṁ nṛ̱ṇāṁ nṛ̍pate jāyase̱ śuci̍ḥ ||
english: You, O Agni, are born from the heavens; you, the swiftly blazing one, from the waters; you from the rock; you from the forests; you from the plants; you, O lord of men, are born pure.

sanskrit: tavā̍gne ho̱traṁ tava̍ po̱tram ṛ̱tviya̱ṁ tava̍ ne̱ṣṭraṁ tvam a̱gnid ṛ̍tāya̱taḥ | tava̍ praśā̱straṁ tvam a̍dhvarīyasi bra̱hmā cāsi̍ gṛ̱hapa̍tiś ca no̱ dame̍ ||
english: Yours, O Agni, is the Hotṛ-office; yours the seasonal Potṛ-office; yours the Neṣṭṛ-office; you, engaged in the rite, are the Āgnīdhra. Yours is the Praśāstṛ-function; you perform the Adhvaryu duties; and you are both the Brahman-priest and the master of our house.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gna̱ indro̍ vṛṣa̱bhaḥ sa̱tām a̍si̱ tvaṁ viṣṇu̍r urugā̱yo na̍ma̱sya̍ḥ | tvam bra̱hmā ra̍yi̱vid bra̍hmaṇas pate̱ tvaṁ vi̍dhartaḥ sacase̱ pura̍ṁdhyā ||
english: You, O Agni, are Indra, the bull of the righteous; you are Viṣṇu of the wide stride, worthy of reverence. You are Brahmā, the finder of wealth, O lord of prayer; you, the upholder, preside with abundant wisdom.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne̱ rājā̱ varu̍ṇo dhṛ̱tavra̍ta̱s tvam mi̱tro bha̍vasi da̱sma īḍya̍ḥ | tvam a̍rya̱mā satpa̍ti̱r yasya̍ sa̱mbhuja̱ṁ tvam aṁśo̍ vi̱dathe̍ deva bhāja̱yuḥ ||
english: You, O Agni, are King Varuṇa who holds firm his ordinances; you become Mitra, the wonderful, worthy of praise. You are Aryaman, the lord of the righteous, at whose table all share; you are Aṁśa, O god, the apportioner at the assembly.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne̱ tvaṣṭā̍ vidha̱te su̱vīrya̱ṁ tava̱ gnāvo̍ mitramahaḥ sajā̱tya̍m | tvam ā̍śu̱hemā̍ rariṣe̱ svaśvya̱ṁ tvaṁ na̱rāṁ śardho̍ asi purū̱vasu̍ḥ ||
english: You, O Agni, are Tvaṣṭṛ granting heroic offspring to the worshiper; yours are the wives of the gods — of Mitra's greatness is the kinship. You swiftly hasten to bestow wealth in fine horses; you are the host of men, O Purūvasu, rich in many goods.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne ru̱dro asu̍ro ma̱ho di̱vas tvaṁ śardho̱ māru̍tam pṛ̱kṣa ī̍śiṣe | tvaṁ vātai̍r aru̱ṇair yā̍si śaṁga̱yas tvam pū̱ṣā vi̍dha̱taḥ pā̍si̱ nu tmanā̍ ||
english: You, O Agni, are Rudra, the mighty Asura of the great sky; you command the troop of the Maruts, the nourishing ones. You travel with the ruddy winds as your auspicious companions; you are Pūṣan who guards the worshiper by your very nature.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne draviṇo̱dā a̍ra̱ṁkṛte̱ tvaṁ de̱vaḥ sa̍vi̱tā ra̍tna̱dhā a̍si | tvam bhago̍ nṛpate̱ vasva̍ īśiṣe̱ tvam pā̱yur dame̱ yas te 'vi̍dhat ||
english: You, O Agni, are the giver of wealth to the one who worships fitly; you are the god Savitṛ, the bestower of treasures. You are Bhaga, O lord of men, and you command wealth; you are the guardian in the house of whoever has honored you.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne̱ dama̱ ā vi̱śpati̱ṁ viśa̱s tvāṁ rājā̍naṁ suvi̱datra̍m ṛñjate | tvaṁ viśvā̍ni svanīka patyase̱ tvaṁ sa̱hasrā̍ṇi śa̱tā daśa̱ prati̍ ||
english: You, O Agni, the tribes worship as the lord of the house in their home; the peoples adore you as their king who bestows favor well. You preside over all things, O bright-faced one; you face a thousand hundreds and tens.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne pi̱tara̍m i̱ṣṭibhi̱r nara̱s tvām bhrā̱trāya̱ śamyā̍ tanū̱ruca̍m | tvam pu̱tro bha̍vasi̱ yas te 'vi̍dha̱t tvaṁ sakhā̍ su̱śeva̍ḥ pāsy ā̱dhṛṣa̍ḥ ||
english: You, O Agni, do men worship as a father with oblations; they seek you as a brother for their comfort, you who shine in your body. You become a son to one who has honored you; you, a kind and unchecked friend, are their protector.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gna ṛ̱bhur ā̱ke na̍ma̱sya1̱̍s tvaṁ vāja̍sya kṣu̱mato̍ rā̱ya ī̍śiṣe | tvaṁ vi bhā̱sy anu̍ dakṣi dā̱vane̱ tvaṁ vi̱śikṣu̍r asi ya̱jñam ā̱tani̍ḥ ||
english: You, O Agni, are the Ṛbhu at the summit, worthy of homage; you command the wealth of nourishing sustenance. You shine forth, O Dakṣa, for the giving of gifts; you are the all-directing one, the extender of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne̱ adi̍tir deva dā̱śuṣe̱ tvaṁ hotrā̱ bhāra̍tī vardhase gi̱rā | tvam iḻā̍ śa̱tahi̍māsi̱ dakṣa̍se̱ tvaṁ vṛ̍tra̱hā va̍supate̱ sara̍svatī ||
english: You, O Agni, are Aditi to the worshiper, O god; you as Bhāratī, the invocation-goddess, grow through praise. You are Iḷā of the hundred winters, skilled in action; you are Sarasvatī, O lord of wealth, the slayer of Vṛtra.

sanskrit: tvam a̍gne̱ subhṛ̍ta utta̱maṁ vaya̱s tava̍ spā̱rhe varṇa̱ ā sa̱ṁdṛśi̱ śriya̍ḥ | tvaṁ vāja̍ḥ pra̱tara̍ṇo bṛ̱hann a̍si̱ tvaṁ ra̱yir ba̍hu̱lo vi̱śvata̍s pṛ̱thuḥ ||
english: You, O Agni, well-nourished, are the most exalted bird; in your desirable color is the beauty of sight. You are the great, forward-advancing food-strength; you are the abundant, all-pervading, wide wealth.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gna ādi̱tyāsa̍ ā̱sya1̱̍ṁ tvāṁ ji̱hvāṁ śuca̍yaś cakrire kave | tvāṁ rā̍ti̱ṣāco̍ adhva̱reṣu̍ saścire̱ tve de̱vā ha̱vir a̍da̱nty āhu̍tam ||
english: You, O Agni, have the Ādityas made their mouth; the pure ones have made you their tongue, O seer. The gift-seekers follow you at the sacrifices; in you the gods eat the offered oblation.

sanskrit: tve a̍gne̱ viśve̍ a̱mṛtā̍so a̱druha̍ ā̱sā de̱vā ha̱vir a̍da̱nty āhu̍tam | tvayā̱ martā̍saḥ svadanta āsu̱tiṁ tvaṁ garbho̍ vī̱rudhā̍ṁ jajñiṣe̱ śuci̍ḥ ||
english: In you, O Agni, all the immortal, un-treacherous gods eat the offered oblation with open mouth. Through you mortals relish the libation; you, the pure one, were born as the embryo of the plants.

sanskrit: tvaṁ tān saṁ ca̱ prati̍ cāsi ma̱jmanāgne̍ sujāta̱ pra ca̍ deva ricyase | pṛ̱kṣo yad atra̍ mahi̱nā vi te̱ bhuva̱d anu̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī roda̍sī u̱bhe ||
english: You are with them all and you face them all, O Agni, well-born; and you, O god, are far-surpassing. For here, in your greatness, the strengthening force pervades, and both the world-halves, heaven and earth, follow you.

sanskrit: ye sto̱tṛbhyo̱ goa̍grā̱m aśva̍peśasa̱m agne̍ rā̱tim u̍pasṛ̱janti̍ sū̱raya̍ḥ | a̱smāñ ca̱ tām̐ś ca̱ pra hi neṣi̱ vasya̱ ā bṛ̱had va̍dema vi̱dathe̍ su̱vīrā̍ḥ ||
english: The generous lords who send forth for the praisers the gift headed by cattle and adorned with horses — O Agni, lead both us and them to better fortune. May we speak great words at the assembly, possessed of heroes.

sanskrit: ya̱jñena̍ vardhata jā̱tave̍dasam a̱gniṁ ya̍jadhvaṁ ha̱viṣā̱ tanā̍ gi̱rā | sa̱mi̱dhā̱naṁ su̍pra̱yasa̱ṁ sva̍rṇaraṁ dyu̱kṣaṁ hotā̍raṁ vṛ̱jane̍ṣu dhū̱rṣada̍m ||
english: Make Jātavedas grow through the sacrifice; worship Agni with oblation, with your whole being, with hymn — him the enkindled, the one of good cheer, whose men are noble, the heavenly Hotṛ, enthroned at the forepost in the assemblies.

sanskrit: a̱bhi tvā̱ naktī̍r u̱ṣaso̍ vavāśi̱re 'gne̍ va̱tsaṁ na svasa̍reṣu dhe̱nava̍ḥ | di̱va i̱ved a̍ra̱tir mānu̍ṣā yu̱gā kṣapo̍ bhāsi puruvāra sa̱ṁyata̍ḥ ||
english: Toward you the nights and dawns have lowed, O Agni, like milch-cows toward their calves at their resting-places. Like heaven's hub you illumine the generations of men; you shine through the nights, O much-desired one, ever watchful.

sanskrit: taṁ de̱vā bu̱dhne raja̍saḥ su̱daṁsa̍saṁ di̱vaspṛ̍thi̱vyor a̍ra̱tiṁ ny e̍rire | ratha̍m iva̱ vedya̍ṁ śu̱kraśo̍ciṣam a̱gnim mi̱traṁ na kṣi̱tiṣu̍ pra̱śaṁsya̍m ||
english: Him of wondrous deeds the gods have set down as the hub at the base of the atmospheric realm, the charioteer between heaven and earth — Agni bright-flaming as a car worthy of knowledge, praiseworthy among settlements like Mitra.

sanskrit: tam u̱kṣamā̍ṇa̱ṁ raja̍si̱ sva ā dame̍ ca̱ndram i̍va su̱ruca̍ṁ hvā̱ra ā da̍dhuḥ | pṛśnyā̍ḥ pata̱raṁ ci̱taya̍ntam a̱kṣabhi̍ḥ pā̱tho na pā̱yuṁ jana̍sī u̱bhe anu̍ ||
english: Him sprinkling in the atmosphere, in his own house, shining like the moon, bright-gleaming, in the curve they have placed — the offspring of the speckled one who illumines with his eyes, like a guardian at the ford, following both peoples.

sanskrit: sa hotā̱ viśva̱m pari̍ bhūtv adhva̱raṁ tam u̍ ha̱vyair manu̍ṣa ṛñjate gi̱rā | hi̱ri̱śi̱pro vṛ̍dhasā̱nāsu̱ jarbhu̍ra̱d dyaur na stṛbhi̍ś citaya̱d roda̍sī̱ anu̍ ||
english: Let that Hotṛ encompass the whole sacrifice; him too men adorn with oblations and song. Golden-jawed, he roars as he grows among the kindlings, illumining the two world-halves as heaven does with stars.

sanskrit: sa no̍ re̱vat sa̍midhā̱naḥ sva̱staye̍ saṁdada̱svān ra̱yim a̱smāsu̍ dīdihi | ā na̍ḥ kṛṇuṣva suvi̱tāya̱ roda̍sī̱ agne̍ ha̱vyā manu̍ṣo deva vī̱taye̍ ||
english: Enkindled, bringing wealth, shine for us as an auspicious boon; bestow and cause wealth to blaze among us. Make the two world-halves favorable to us, O Agni; be pleased with the oblations of man, O god.

sanskrit: dā no̍ agne bṛha̱to dāḥ sa̍ha̱sriṇo̍ du̱ro na vāja̱ṁ śrutyā̱ apā̍ vṛdhi | prācī̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī brahma̍ṇā kṛdhi̱ sva1̱̍r ṇa śu̱kram u̱ṣaso̱ vi di̍dyutaḥ ||
english: Give us, O Agni, the great gift worth thousands; increase like a door that yields strength, O widely famed one. Make heaven and earth favorable to us through prayer; shine brightly like the sun at the dawns.

sanskrit: sa i̍dhā̱na u̱ṣaso̱ rāmyā̱ anu̱ sva1̱̍r ṇa dī̍ded aru̱ṣeṇa̍ bhā̱nunā̍ | hotrā̍bhir a̱gnir manu̍ṣaḥ svadhva̱ro rājā̍ vi̱śām ati̍thi̱ś cāru̍r ā̱yave̍ ||
english: Enkindled, following the pleasant nights in order, may he shine like the sun with his red-gleaming light. Agni with his invocations is the well-sacrificing one of men, the king of the peoples, the beloved guest for the mortal.

sanskrit: e̱vā no̍ agne a̱mṛte̍ṣu pūrvya̱ dhīṣ pī̍pāya bṛ̱haddi̍veṣu̱ mānu̍ṣā | duhā̍nā dhe̱nur vṛ̱jane̍ṣu kā̱rave̱ tmanā̍ śa̱tina̍m puru̱rūpa̍m i̱ṣaṇi̍ ||
english: Thus among the immortals, O primal Agni, has our thought been nourished in the great heavens, among human beings — like a milch-cow yielding for the singer at the assemblies, of herself driving forth the hundredfold, manifold vigor.

sanskrit: va̱yam a̍gne̱ arva̍tā vā su̱vīrya̱m brahma̍ṇā vā citayemā̱ janā̱m̐ ati̍ | a̱smāka̍ṁ dyu̱mnam adhi̱ pañca̍ kṛ̱ṣṭiṣū̱ccā sva1̱̍r ṇa śu̍śucīta du̱ṣṭara̍m ||
english: May we, O Agni, illumine the peoples — whether through a swift horse or through heroic strength or through prayer. May our glory above the five peoples shine high and unassailable like the unconquerable sun.

sanskrit: sa no̍ bodhi sahasya pra̱śaṁsyo̱ yasmi̍n sujā̱tā i̱ṣaya̍nta sū̱raya̍ḥ | yam a̍gne ya̱jñam u̍pa̱yanti̍ vā̱jino̱ nitye̍ to̱ke dī̍di̱vāṁsa̱ṁ sve dame̍ ||
english: Be aware of us — you, the powerful, the praiseworthy, in whom the well-born generous ones are active — the sacrifice, O Agni, which the vigorous ones approach, shining perpetually on their offspring in their own house.

sanskrit: u̱bhayā̍so jātavedaḥ syāma te sto̱tāro̍ agne sū̱raya̍ś ca̱ śarma̍ṇi | vasvo̍ rā̱yaḥ pu̍ruśca̱ndrasya̱ bhūya̍saḥ pra̱jāva̍taḥ svapa̱tyasya̍ śagdhi naḥ ||
english: May we both — the praisers and the generous, O Jātavedas, O Agni — abide in your shelter. Grant us the abundant, many-gleaming wealth of cattle, with offspring and good progeny.

sanskrit: ye sto̱tṛbhyo̱ goa̍grā̱m aśva̍peśasa̱m agne̍ rā̱tim u̍pasṛ̱janti̍ sū̱raya̍ḥ | a̱smāñ ca̱ tām̐ś ca̱ pra hi neṣi̱ vasya̱ ā bṛ̱had va̍dema vi̱dathe̍ su̱vīrā̍ḥ ||
english: The generous lords who send forth for the praisers the gift headed by cattle and adorned with horses — O Agni, lead both us and them to better fortune. May we speak great words at the assembly, possessed of heroes.

sanskrit: sami̍ddho a̱gnir nihi̍taḥ pṛthi̱vyām pra̱tyaṅ viśvā̍ni̱ bhuva̍nāni asthāt | hotā̍ pāva̱kaḥ pra̱diva̍ḥ sume̱dhā de̱vo de̱vān ya̍jatv a̱gnir arha̍n ||
english: Agni, enkindled, set in the earth, has stood facing all the worlds. The Hotṛ, the purifier, from of old of good intelligence — may Agni, the god worthy of the gods, sacrifice to the gods.

sanskrit: narā̱śaṁsa̱ḥ prati̱ dhāmā̍ny a̱ñjan ti̱sro diva̱ḥ prati̍ ma̱hnā sva̱rciḥ | ghṛ̱ta̱pruṣā̱ mana̍sā ha̱vyam u̱ndan mū̱rdhan ya̱jñasya̱ sam a̍naktu de̱vān ||
english: Narāśaṁsa, adorning all the dwellings, radiant in his own light against the three heights of heaven — let him, sprinkling with ghee, with willing mind, moistening the oblation, anoint the gods at the head of the sacrifice.

sanskrit: ī̱ḻi̱to a̍gne̱ mana̍sā no̱ arha̍n de̱vān ya̍kṣi̱ mānu̍ṣā̱t pūrvo̍ a̱dya | sa ā va̍ha ma̱rutā̱ṁ śardho̱ acyu̍ta̱m indra̍ṁ naro barhi̱ṣada̍ṁ yajadhvam ||
english: Praised, O Agni, with mind, being worthy of us, sacrifice to the gods today, going before mankind. Bring hither the unshaken host of Maruts and Indra; men, worship the one who is seated on the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit: deva̍ barhi̱r vardha̍mānaṁ su̱vīra̍ṁ stī̱rṇaṁ rā̱ye su̱bhara̱ṁ vedy a̱syām | ghṛ̱tenā̱ktaṁ va̍savaḥ sīdate̱daṁ viśve̍ devā ādityā ya̱jñiyā̍saḥ ||
english: The divine sacrificial grass, growing, filled with heroes, spread out for wealth, easily borne on this altar, anointed with ghee — let the Vasus, the Viśve Devāḥ, the Ādityas, the worthy of sacrifice, sit upon it.

sanskrit: vi śra̍yantām urvi̱yā hū̱yamā̍nā̱ dvāro̍ de̱vīḥ su̍prāya̱ṇā namo̍bhiḥ | vyaca̍svatī̱r vi pra̍thantām aju̱ryā varṇa̍m punā̱nā ya̱śasa̍ṁ su̱vīra̍m ||
english: Let the divine Doors, being called upon, spread wide, well-approached with reverences; wide-extending, let them spread out, ever-young, purifying the glorious color abounding in heroes.

sanskrit: sā̱dhv apā̍ṁsi sa̱natā̍ na ukṣi̱te u̱ṣāsā̱naktā̍ va̱yye̍va raṇvi̱te | tantu̍ṁ ta̱taṁ sa̱ṁvaya̍ntī samī̱cī ya̱jñasya̱ peśa̍ḥ su̱dughe̱ paya̍svatī ||
english: Performing their good deeds, moistened as by ancient rains, Dawn and Night delight like two weavers at their work. Weaving together the stretched thread, facing each other — let them adorn the sacrifice with milk, well-yielding.

sanskrit: daivyā̱ hotā̍rā pratha̱mā vi̱duṣṭa̍ra ṛ̱ju ya̍kṣata̱ḥ sam ṛ̱cā va̱puṣṭa̍rā | de̱vān yaja̍ntāv ṛtu̱thā sam a̍ñjato̱ nābhā̍ pṛthi̱vyā adhi̱ sānu̍ṣu tri̱ṣu ||
english: The two divine Hotṛ-priests, the first, the more knowing, sacrifice straightforwardly, the more wondrous with their hymn. Anointing one another, sacrificing to the gods in due season, at the navel of the earth, upon the three ridges.

sanskrit: sara̍svatī sā̱dhaya̍ntī̱ dhiya̍ṁ na̱ iḻā̍ de̱vī bhāra̍tī vi̱śvatū̍rtiḥ ||tirsro de̱vīḥ sva̱dhayā̍ ba̱rhir edam acchi̍dram pāntu śara̱ṇaṁ ni̱ṣadya̍ ||
english: Sarasvatī, perfecting our prayer, and Iḷā the goddess, and Bhāratī all-pervading — these three goddesses, sitting down, guard this unbroken refuge with their own nature.

sanskrit: pi̱śaṅga̍rūpaḥ su̱bharo̍ vayo̱dhāḥ śru̱ṣṭī vī̱ro jā̍yate de̱vakā̍maḥ | pra̱jāṁ tvaṣṭā̱ vi ṣya̍tu̱ nābhi̍m a̱sme athā̍ de̱vānā̱m apy e̍tu̱ pātha̍ḥ ||
english: Of reddish form, well-supporting, food-giving — an obedient hero desiring the gods is born. May Tvaṣṭṛ loosen the navel of progeny in us; then may the path of the gods also reach us.

sanskrit: vana̱spati̍r avasṛ̱jann upa̍ sthād a̱gnir ha̱viḥ sū̍dayāti̱ pra dhī̱bhiḥ | tridhā̱ sama̍ktaṁ nayatu prajā̱nan de̱vebhyo̱ daivya̍ḥ śami̱topa̍ ha̱vyam ||
english: The tree of the forest, releasing it, comes to the fore; Agni advances the oblation with his thoughts. Knowing its threefold anointing, may the divine slaughterer lead the oblation to the gods.

sanskrit: ghṛ̱tam mi̍mikṣe ghṛ̱tam a̍sya̱ yoni̍r ghṛ̱te śri̱to ghṛ̱tam v a̍sya̱ dhāma̍ | a̱nu̱ṣva̱dham ā va̍ha mā̱daya̍sva̱ svāhā̍kṛtaṁ vṛṣabha vakṣi ha̱vyam ||
english: Ghee is sprinkled; ghee is his womb; he is established in ghee; ghee is his very dwelling. Bring hither in order; delight yourself; carry the oblation consecrated with Svāhā, O bull.

sanskrit: hu̱ve va̍ḥ su̱dyotmā̍naṁ suvṛ̱ktiṁ vi̱śām a̱gnim ati̍thiṁ supra̱yasa̍m | mi̱tra i̍va̱ yo di̍dhi̱ṣāyyo̱ bhūd de̱va āde̍ve̱ jane̍ jā̱tave̍dāḥ ||
english: I call for you the brilliantly shining one, the well-lauded one, Agni the guest of the peoples, of fine gifts — he who has become beloved like Mitra, Jātavedas the god among godless folk.

sanskrit: i̱maṁ vi̱dhanto̍ a̱pāṁ sa̱dhasthe̍ dvi̱tāda̍dhu̱r bhṛga̍vo vi̱kṣv ā̱3̱̍yoḥ | e̱ṣa viśvā̍ny a̱bhy a̍stu̱ bhūmā̍ de̱vānā̍m a̱gnir a̍ra̱tir jī̱rāśva̍ḥ ||
english: Worshiping him, they placed him a second time at the dwelling-place of the waters; the Bhṛgus placed him among the peoples of Āyu. May this one, the swift-horsed Agni, the hub of the gods, encompass all the beings.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ de̱vāso̱ mānu̍ṣīṣu vi̱kṣu pri̱yaṁ dhu̍ḥ kṣe̱ṣyanto̱ na mi̱tram | sa dī̍dayad uśa̱tīr ūrmyā̱ ā da̱kṣāyyo̱ yo dāsva̍te̱ dama̱ ā ||
english: The gods placed beloved Agni among the human peoples, as they would settle a friend who would dwell among them. He illumines with flame those who desire him — he who is worthy of skill in the house of the generous worshiper.

sanskrit: a̱sya ra̱ṇvā svasye̍va pu̱ṣṭiḥ saṁdṛ̍ṣṭir asya hiyā̱nasya̱ dakṣo̍ḥ | vi yo bhari̍bhra̱d oṣa̍dhīṣu ji̱hvām atyo̱ na rathyo̍ dodhavīti̱ vārā̍n ||
english: Delightful is his nourishment like a possession of one's own; the power of his advancing skill is a joy to see. He who thrusts out his tongue among the plants, tossing like a racehorse, whirling through his obstacles.

sanskrit: ā yan me̱ abhva̍ṁ va̱nada̱ḥ pana̍nto̱śigbhyo̱ nāmi̍mīta̱ varṇa̍m | sa ci̱treṇa̍ cikite̱ raṁsu̍ bhā̱sā ju̍ju̱rvām̐ yo muhu̱r ā yuvā̱ bhūt ||
english: When the forest-eaters, as they marvel at my might, bend their color to the Uśij-fires — he is known in the delightful realm by his variegated brightness, he who, though aged, becomes instantly young again.

sanskrit: ā yo vanā̍ tātṛṣā̱ṇo na bhāti̱ vār ṇa pa̱thā rathye̍va svānīt | kṛ̱ṣṇādhvā̱ tapū̍ ra̱ṇvaś ci̍keta̱ dyaur i̍va̱ smaya̍māno̱ nabho̍bhiḥ ||
english: He who, like one thirsting, shines among the forests; along the path he has roared like a chariot-horse. The scorching one of black trail has become conscious, smiling like heaven with its clouds.

sanskrit: sa yo vy asthā̍d a̱bhi dakṣa̍d u̱rvīm pa̱śur naiti̍ sva̱yur ago̍pāḥ | a̱gniḥ śo̱ciṣmā̍m̐ ata̱sāny u̱ṣṇan kṛ̱ṣṇavya̍thir asvadaya̱n na bhūma̍ ||
english: He who has stood up and encompassed the wide expanse — a beast going of his own will without a herdsman. Agni the flame-possessor, heating the withered plants, causing a black trembling, has not tasted the earth.

sanskrit: nū te̱ pūrva̱syāva̍so̱ adhī̍tau tṛ̱tīye̍ vi̱dathe̱ manma̍ śaṁsi | a̱sme a̍gne sa̱ṁyadvī̍ram bṛ̱hanta̍ṁ kṣu̱manta̱ṁ vāja̍ṁ svapa̱tyaṁ ra̱yiṁ dā̍ḥ ||
english: Now I recite the thought for you in the third assembly, meditating upon your former helping. Bestow on us, O Agni, the great wealth that gathers heroes, the nourishing strength, with good offspring.

sanskrit: tvayā̱ yathā̍ gṛtsama̱dāso̍ agne̱ guhā̍ va̱nvanta̱ upa̍rām̐ a̱bhi ṣyuḥ | su̱vīrā̍so abhimāti̱ṣāha̱ḥ smat sū̱ribhyo̍ gṛṇa̱te tad vayo̍ dhāḥ ||
english: Just as, O Agni, the Gṛtsamadas through you conquered in secret and overwhelmed the adversaries — possessed of heroes, overcoming hostility — bestow that same vitality from the generous ones upon the singer.

sanskrit: hotā̍janiṣṭa̱ ceta̍naḥ pi̱tā pi̱tṛbhya̍ ū̱taye̍ | pra̱yakṣa̱ñ jenya̱ṁ vasu̍ śa̱kema̍ vā̱jino̱ yama̍m ||
english: The conscious Hotṛ has been born, a father for the fathers' aid. Offering excellent wealth, may we, the vigorous, be able to attain the rein.

sanskrit: ā yasmi̍n sa̱pta ra̱śmaya̍s ta̱tā ya̱jñasya̍ ne̱tari̍ | ma̱nu̱ṣvad daivya̍m aṣṭa̱mam potā̱ viśva̱ṁ tad i̍nvati ||
english: In him who is the leader of the sacrifice, seven cords are stretched; the Potṛ, as a man of the gods, drives the eighth — the divine one; he pervades all that.

sanskrit: da̱dha̱nve vā̱ yad ī̱m anu̱ voca̱d brahmā̍ṇi̱ ver u̱ tat | pari̱ viśvā̍ni̱ kāvyā̍ ne̱miś ca̱kram i̍vābhavat ||
english: He has indeed sustained it; verily, when the Brahman-priest has spoken the holy words after him, the wheel-rim has encompassed all poetic wisdom as the felly of a wheel.

sanskrit: sā̱kaṁ hi śuci̍nā̱ śuci̍ḥ praśā̱stā kratu̱nāja̍ni | vi̱dvām̐ a̍sya vra̱tā dhru̱vā va̱yā i̱vānu̍ rohate ||
english: For the pure Praśāstṛ together with the pure, knowing its fixed ordinances, was born with his power of will; he mounts up following them like branches.

sanskrit: tā a̍sya̱ varṇa̍m ā̱yuvo̱ neṣṭu̍ḥ sacanta dhe̱nava̍ḥ | ku̱vit ti̱sṛbhya̱ ā vara̱ṁ svasā̍ro̱ yā i̱daṁ ya̱yuḥ ||
english: The milch-cows of Āyu attend the color of this Neṣṭṛ. Perhaps the sisters who have come to this — will they bring a choice gift from the three?

sanskrit: yadī̍ mā̱tur upa̱ svasā̍ ghṛ̱tam bhara̱nty asthi̍ta | tāsā̍m adhva̱ryur āga̍tau̱ yavo̍ vṛ̱ṣṭīva̍ modate ||
english: When the sister approaches the mother bringing ghee to where she stands, the Adhvaryu rejoices at their coming like barley at rain.

sanskrit: svaḥ svāya̱ dhāya̍se kṛṇu̱tām ṛ̱tvig ṛ̱tvija̍m | stoma̍ṁ ya̱jñaṁ cād ara̍ṁ va̱nemā̍ rari̱mā va̱yam ||
english: Let the seasonal priest make heaven for his own heaven-seeker; the laud and the sacrifice — we have been adequate; we have given; we have won.

sanskrit: yathā̍ vi̱dvām̐ ara̱ṁ kara̱d viśve̍bhyo yaja̱tebhya̍ḥ | a̱yam a̍gne̱ tve api̱ yaṁ ya̱jñaṁ ca̍kṛ̱mā va̱yam ||
english: As a knowing one may do what is fit for all the adorable gods — this sacrifice which we have made, O Agni, let it also be in you.

sanskrit: i̱mām me̍ agne sa̱midha̍m i̱mām u̍pa̱sada̍ṁ vaneḥ | i̱mā u̱ ṣu śru̍dhī̱ gira̍ḥ ||
english: Accept for me, O Agni, this kindling-wood, accept this drawing-near; and listen to these songs.

sanskrit: a̱yā te̍ agne vidhe̱morjo̍ napā̱d aśva̍miṣṭe | e̱nā sū̱ktena̍ sujāta ||
english: With this, O Agni, for your worshiper — O grandson of strength, desired of horses — with this well-spoken hymn, O well-born one.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā̍ gī̱rbhir girva̍ṇasaṁ draviṇa̱syuṁ dra̍viṇodaḥ | sa̱pa̱ryema̍ sapa̱ryava̍ḥ ||
english: You who are pleased by song and longing for wealth, O giver of wealth — may we, reverencing you with hymns, pay you homage.

sanskrit: sa bo̍dhi sū̱rir ma̱ghavā̱ vasu̍pate̱ vasu̍dāvan | yu̱yo̱dhy a1̱̍smad dveṣā̍ṁsi ||
english: Be aware of us — O sage, O bountiful one, O lord of wealth, O giver of wealth — drive away from us all enmities.

sanskrit: sa no̍ vṛ̱ṣṭiṁ di̱vas pari̱ sa no̱ vāja̍m ana̱rvāṇa̍m | sa na̍ḥ saha̱sriṇī̱r iṣa̍ḥ ||
english: May he give us rain from the sky; may he give us strength that meets no opposition; may he give us thousandfold refreshments.

sanskrit: īḻā̍nāyāva̱syave̱ yavi̍ṣṭha dūta no gi̱rā | yaji̍ṣṭha hota̱r ā ga̍hi ||
english: O youngest, for the praiser who seeks your aid — come as our messenger with our hymn, O most sacrificing Hotṛ.

sanskrit: a̱ntar hy a̍gna̱ īya̍se vi̱dvāñ janmo̱bhayā̍ kave | dū̱to janye̍va̱ mitrya̍ḥ ||
english: For, O Agni, you travel between the two births, O knowing, O seer — as a friendly messenger among the people.

sanskrit: sa vi̱dvām̐ ā ca̍ piprayo̱ yakṣi̍ cikitva ānu̱ṣak | ā cā̱smin sa̍tsi ba̱rhiṣi̍ ||
english: You who know, fill us too; O knowing one, sacrifice in order; and sit down on this sacrificial grass.

sanskrit: śreṣṭha̍ṁ yaviṣṭha bhāra̱tāgne̍ dyu̱manta̱m ā bha̍ra | vaso̍ puru̱spṛha̍ṁ ra̱yim ||
english: O youngest, O Agni of the Bharata-clan, bring the most excellent, radiant wealth — O Vasu, wealth longed for by many.

sanskrit: mā no̱ arā̍tir īśata de̱vasya̱ martya̍sya ca | parṣi̱ tasyā̍ u̱ta dvi̱ṣaḥ ||
english: Let no niggardliness of the divine or the mortal master us; carry us across that also, and across enmity.

sanskrit: viśvā̍ u̱ta tvayā̍ va̱yaṁ dhārā̍ uda̱nyā̍ iva | ati̍ gāhemahi̱ dviṣa̍ḥ ||
english: And through you may we, like rivers in flood, wade across all enmities.

sanskrit: śuci̍ḥ pāvaka̱ vandyo 'gne̍ bṛ̱had vi ro̍case | tvaṁ ghṛ̱tebhi̱r āhu̍taḥ ||
english: O Agni, pure, purifying, worthy of praise — you shine forth greatly; you are invoked with ladles of ghee.

sanskrit: tvaṁ no̍ asi bhāra̱tāgne̍ va̱śābhi̍r u̱kṣabhi̍ḥ | a̱ṣṭāpa̍dībhi̱r āhu̍taḥ ||
english: You, O Agni of the Bharata-clan, are ours, invoked with cows and bulls and eight-footed victims.

sanskrit: drva̍nnaḥ sa̱rpirā̍sutiḥ pra̱tno hotā̱ vare̍ṇyaḥ | saha̍sas pu̱tro adbhu̍taḥ ||
english: Whose food is dry wood, whose libation is ghee — the ancient, deserving, desirable Hotṛ, the wondrous son of strength.

sanskrit: vā̱ja̱yann i̍va̱ nū rathā̱n yogā̍m̐ a̱gner upa̍ stuhi | ya̱śasta̍masya mī̱ḻhuṣa̍ḥ ||
english: As if hastening for prizes — now praise the harnessing of Agni's cars, of the most glorious, the bountiful one.

sanskrit: yaḥ su̍nī̱tho da̍dā̱śuṣe̍ 'ju̱ryo ja̱raya̍nn a̱rim | cāru̍pratīka̱ āhu̍taḥ ||
english: He who is of good guidance for the worshiper, the undecaying, wearing out the enemy — of beautiful aspect, invoked with oblations.

sanskrit: ya u̍ śri̱yā dame̍ṣv ā do̱ṣoṣasi̍ praśa̱syate̍ | yasya̍ vra̱taṁ na mīya̍te ||
english: He who, in his beauty, is praised in the houses at dusk and dawn — whose ordinance is never diminished.

sanskrit: ā yaḥ sva1̱̍r ṇa bhā̱nunā̍ ci̱tro vi̱bhāty a̱rciṣā̍ | a̱ñjā̱no a̱jarai̍r a̱bhi ||
english: He who, like the sun, shines brightly with his beam, gleaming with his flame — anointed with undecaying ones all around.

sanskrit: atri̱m anu̍ sva̱rājya̍m a̱gnim u̱kthāni̍ vāvṛdhuḥ | viśvā̱ adhi̱ śriyo̍ dadhe ||
english: After Atri — the self-ruling Agni — the praises have increased; he has assumed all glories.

sanskrit: a̱gner indra̍sya̱ soma̍sya de̱vānā̍m ū̱tibhi̍r va̱yam | ari̍ṣyantaḥ sacemahy a̱bhi ṣyā̍ma pṛtanya̱taḥ ||
english: With the aids of Agni, Indra, Soma, and the gods, may we, remaining unharmed, keep company and overcome those who battle against us.

sanskrit: ni hotā̍ hotṛ̱ṣada̍ne̱ vidā̍nas tve̱ṣo dī̍di̱vām̐ a̍sadat su̱dakṣa̍ḥ | ada̍bdhavratapramati̱r vasi̍ṣṭhaḥ sahasrambha̱raḥ śuci̍jihvo a̱gniḥ ||
english: The Hotṛ, perceiving, fierce, blazing, skilled, has sat down in the Hotṛ's seat — Agni, whose ordinance is undeceived, whose insight is excellent, most excellent, carrier of a thousand, pure-tongued.

sanskrit: tvaṁ dū̱tas tvam u̍ naḥ para̱spās tvaṁ vasya̱ ā vṛ̍ṣabha praṇe̱tā | agne̍ to̱kasya̍ na̱s tane̍ ta̱nūnā̱m apra̍yuccha̱n dīdya̍d bodhi go̱pāḥ ||
english: You are the messenger; you are our protector across; you, O bull, are the guide to better things. Be the unwavering, shining guardian, O Agni, of our offspring and the continuation of our persons.

sanskrit: vi̱dhema̍ te para̱me janma̍nn agne vi̱dhema̱ stomai̱r ava̍re sa̱dhasthe̍ | yasmā̱d yone̍r u̱dāri̍thā̱ yaje̱ tam pra tve ha̱vīṁṣi̍ juhure̱ sami̍ddhe ||
english: May we worship you in your supreme birth, O Agni; may we worship you with praises in the lower dwelling. The womb from which you have arisen — that I sacrifice to; into you when enkindled the oblations have been poured.

sanskrit: agne̱ yaja̍sva ha̱viṣā̱ yajī̍yāñ chru̱ṣṭī de̱ṣṇam a̱bhi gṛ̍ṇīhi̱ rādha̍ḥ | tvaṁ hy asi̍ rayi̱patī̍ rayī̱ṇāṁ tvaṁ śu̱krasya̱ vaca̍so ma̱notā̍ ||
english: O Agni, sacrifice with the oblation, O most sacrificing; readily accept the gift-offering of largess. For you are the lord of riches among riches; you are the thinker of the bright word.

sanskrit: u̱bhaya̍ṁ te̱ na kṣī̍yate vasa̱vya̍ṁ di̱ve-di̍ve̱ jāya̍mānasya dasma | kṛ̱dhi kṣu̱manta̍ṁ jari̱tāra̍m agne kṛ̱dhi pati̍ṁ svapa̱tyasya̍ rā̱yaḥ ||
english: Neither part of your wealth diminishes, O wondrous one, being born day by day. Make the singer nourishing, O Agni; make him the lord of wealth with good offspring.

sanskrit: sainānī̍kena suvi̱datro̍ a̱sme yaṣṭā̍ de̱vām̐ āya̍jiṣṭhaḥ sva̱sti | ada̍bdho go̱pā u̱ta na̍ḥ para̱spā agne̍ dyu̱mad u̱ta re̱vad di̍dīhi ||
english: Most beneficent with your array of praisers, the most sacrificing to the gods, auspicious to us — undeceived guardian and our protector across, O Agni, shine brightly and wealth-bestowing.

sanskrit: jo̱hūtro̍ a̱gniḥ pra̍tha̱maḥ pi̱teve̱ḻas pa̱de manu̍ṣā̱ yat sami̍ddhaḥ | śriya̱ṁ vasā̍no a̱mṛto̱ vice̍tā marmṛ̱jenya̍ḥ śrava̱sya1̱̍ḥ sa vā̱jī ||
english: Agni, oft-invoked, the first, at the step of the father-like Iḷā, enkindled among mankind — clothed in beauty, the immortal, the all-wise, worthy of being cleansed, seeking glory — he is the victorious one.

sanskrit: śrū̱yā a̱gniś ci̱trabhā̍nu̱r hava̍m me̱ viśvā̍bhir gī̱rbhir a̱mṛto̱ vice̍tāḥ | śyā̱vā ratha̍ṁ vahato̱ rohi̍tā vo̱tāru̱ṣāha̍ cakre̱ vibhṛ̍traḥ ||
english: May Agni of brilliant radiance hear my call with all his hymns — immortal, all-wise. The dark ones and the red carry his car; he has made a wheel bearing Dawn's overcoming — he who is all-supporting.

sanskrit: u̱ttā̱nāyā̍m ajanaya̱n suṣū̍ta̱m bhuva̍d a̱gniḥ pu̍ru̱peśā̍su̱ garbha̍ḥ | śiri̍ṇāyāṁ cid a̱ktunā̱ maho̍bhi̱r apa̍rīvṛto vasati̱ prace̍tāḥ ||
english: They generated the well-born one in the one lying open; Agni became the embryo in the manifoldly-adorned ones. Even in the rough one he dwells, enveloped by no one, the all-wise, with his great nocturnal powers.

sanskrit: jigha̍rmy a̱gniṁ ha̱viṣā̍ ghṛ̱tena̍ pratikṣi̱yanta̱m bhuva̍nāni̱ viśvā̍ | pṛ̱thuṁ ti̍ra̱ścā vaya̍sā bṛ̱hanta̱ṁ vyaci̍ṣṭha̱m annai̍ rabha̱saṁ dṛśā̍nam ||
english: I anoint Agni with the ghee-oblation — dwelling opposite all the worlds, broad across, great in body, widest, mighty in food, fierce to behold.

sanskrit: ā vi̱śvata̍ḥ pra̱tyañca̍ṁ jigharmy ara̱kṣasā̱ mana̍sā̱ taj ju̍ṣeta | marya̍śrīḥ spṛha̱yadva̍rṇo a̱gnir nābhi̱mṛśe̍ ta̱nvā̱3̱̍ jarbhu̍rāṇaḥ ||
english: I anoint him facing all around from all sides; with a demon-free mind may he relish it. Agni of manly splendor, of desirable color, roaring without being touched in his body.

sanskrit: jñe̱yā bhā̱gaṁ sa̍hasā̱no vare̍ṇa̱ tvādū̍tāso manu̱vad va̍dema | anū̍nam a̱gniṁ ju̱hvā̍ vaca̱syā ma̍dhu̱pṛca̍ṁ dhana̱sā jo̍havīmi ||
english: Let him be known for his share with overwhelming choice; may we, as messengers of yours, speak after the manner of Manu. I invoke Agni who is complete, with the ladle and speech — the honey-mixed one — with praise.

sanskrit: śru̱dhī hava̍m indra̱ mā ri̍ṣaṇya̱ḥ syāma̍ te dā̱vane̱ vasū̍nām | i̱mā hi tvām ūrjo̍ va̱rdhaya̍nti vasū̱yava̱ḥ sindha̍vo̱ na kṣara̍ntaḥ ||
english: Hear the call, O Indra; may we not be harmed; may we be yours for the giving of wealth. For these streams, flowing like rivers, seeking riches, increase you with their strength.

sanskrit: sṛ̱jo ma̱hīr i̍ndra̱ yā api̍nva̱ḥ pari̍ṣṭhitā̱ ahi̍nā śūra pū̱rvīḥ | ama̍rtyaṁ cid dā̱sam manya̍māna̱m avā̍bhinad u̱kthair vāvṛdhā̱naḥ ||
english: Release the great waters, O Indra, those which swelled but were penned around by the serpent, O hero, the many. He who grew great with praises, he struck down even the immortal-thinking Dāsa.

sanskrit: u̱ktheṣv in nu śū̍ra̱ yeṣu̍ cā̱kan stome̍ṣv indra ru̱driye̍ṣu ca | tubhyed e̱tā yāsu̍ mandasā̱naḥ pra vā̱yave̍ sisrate̱ na śu̱bhrāḥ ||
english: In the praises, O hero, in which you have delighted, O Indra, and in the Rudra-hymns — for you these bright ones, as you rejoice in them, hasten forward like winds.

sanskrit: śu̱bhraṁ nu te̱ śuṣma̍ṁ va̱rdhaya̍ntaḥ śu̱bhraṁ vajra̍m bā̱hvor dadhā̍nāḥ | śu̱bhras tvam i̍ndra vāvṛdhā̱no a̱sme dāsī̱r viśa̱ḥ sūrye̍ṇa sahyāḥ ||
english: Increasing your bright strength, placing the bright thunderbolt in your two arms — bright are you, O Indra, grown great, making the Dāsa-peoples subject to us with the sun.

sanskrit: guhā̍ hi̱taṁ guhya̍ṁ gū̱ḍham a̱psv apī̍vṛtam mā̱yina̍ṁ kṣi̱yanta̍m | u̱to a̱po dyāṁ ta̍sta̱bhvāṁsa̱m aha̱nn ahi̍ṁ śūra vī̱rye̍ṇa ||
english: The hidden one, the secret one, the concealed, shrouded in the waters, the magical one dwelling there — even him who had propped up the waters and the sky — you slew the serpent, O hero, with your heroic power.

sanskrit: stavā̱ nu ta̍ indra pū̱rvyā ma̱hāny u̱ta sta̍vāma̱ nūta̍nā kṛ̱tāni̍ | stavā̱ vajra̍m bā̱hvor u̱śanta̱ṁ stavā̱ harī̱ sūrya̍sya ke̱tū ||
english: Let us laud your former great deeds, O Indra, and let us laud the new ones accomplished. Let us laud the thunderbolt longing in your arms; let us laud the two bays, the banners of the sun.

sanskrit: harī̱ nu ta̍ indra vā̱jaya̍ntā ghṛta̱ścuta̍ṁ svā̱ram a̍svārṣṭām | vi sa̍ma̱nā bhūmi̍r aprathi̱ṣṭāra̍ṁsta̱ parva̍taś cit sari̱ṣyan ||
english: Your two prize-winning bays, O Indra, have struck out the self-poured heavenly mead. The earth spread apart equally; even the mountain stood still about to quake.

sanskrit: ni parva̍taḥ sā̱dy apra̍yuccha̱n sam mā̱tṛbhi̍r vāvaśā̱no a̍krān | dū̱re pā̱re vāṇī̍ṁ va̱rdhaya̍nta̱ indre̍ṣitāṁ dha̱mani̍m papratha̱n ni ||
english: The mountain lay still without swerving; bellowing with its mother-waters, it contracted. In the far distance they increased the voice, spreading out the pipe sent by Indra.

sanskrit: indro̍ ma̱hāṁ sindhu̍m ā̱śayā̍nam māyā̱vina̍ṁ vṛ̱tram a̍sphura̱n niḥ ||are̍jetā̱ṁ roda̍sī bhiyā̱ne kani̍kradato̱ vṛṣṇo̍ asya̱ vajrā̍t ||
english: Indra has kicked out the great Vṛtra lying prone — the magical one. Both world-halves trembled in fear at the thunderbolt of this roaring bull.

sanskrit: aro̍ravī̱d vṛṣṇo̍ asya̱ vajro 'mā̍nuṣa̱ṁ yan mānu̍ṣo ni̱jūrvā̍t | ni mā̱yino̍ dāna̱vasya̍ mā̱yā apā̍dayat papi̱vān su̱tasya̍ ||
english: The thunderbolt of this bull bellowed out — what the inhuman one can overwhelm the human. Having drunk the pressed Soma, he brought down the magic of the magical Dānava.

sanskrit: pibā̍-pi̱bed i̍ndra śūra̱ soma̱m manda̍ntu tvā ma̱ndina̍ḥ su̱tāsa̍ḥ ||pṛ̱ṇanta̍s te ku̱kṣī va̍rdhayantv i̱tthā su̱taḥ pau̱ra indra̍m āva ||
english: Drink and drink again, O Indra, O hero; may the exhilarating pressed ones exhilarate you. Let those who fill your flanks increase you; thus the pressed drink of the citizen has helped Indra.

sanskrit: tve i̱ndrāpy a̍bhūma̱ viprā̱ dhiya̍ṁ vanema ṛta̱yā sapa̍ntaḥ | a̱va̱syavo̍ dhīmahi̱ praśa̍stiṁ sa̱dyas te̍ rā̱yo dā̱vane̍ syāma ||
english: In you, O Indra, we have become inspired seers; seeking your grace, we would gain the thought with truth. May we who seek your help hold fast to your praise; may we at once be yours for the giving of riches.

sanskrit: syāma̱ te ta̍ indra̱ ye ta̍ ū̱tī a̍va̱syava̱ ūrja̍ṁ va̱rdhaya̍ntaḥ | śu̱ṣminta̍ma̱ṁ yaṁ cā̱kanā̍ma devā̱sme ra̱yiṁ rā̍si vī̱rava̍ntam ||
english: May we be of those, O Indra, who, with your help, seek your aid, increasing your strength. O god, bestow on us the wealth abounding in heroes — that most vigorous gift for which we have longed.

sanskrit: rāsi̱ kṣaya̱ṁ rāsi̍ mi̱tram a̱sme rāsi̱ śardha̍ indra̱ māru̍taṁ naḥ | sa̱joṣa̍so̱ ye ca̍ mandasā̱nāḥ pra vā̱yava̍ḥ pā̱nty agra̍ṇītim ||
english: Grant us dwelling; grant us friendship; grant us, O Indra, the Marut-host. Those who rejoice together, who are exhilarated — the winds guard the foremost leader.

sanskrit: vyantv in nu yeṣu̍ mandasā̱nas tṛ̱pat soma̍m pāhi dra̱hyad i̍ndra | a̱smān su pṛ̱tsv ā ta̍ru̱trāva̍rdhayo̱ dyām bṛ̱hadbhi̍r a̱rkaiḥ ||
english: Let those in whom you, exhilarated, having drunk, have been satisfied pass through, O Indra, O firm one. You have increased us well in battles as conquerors, with great hymns to the sky.

sanskrit: bṛ̱hanta̱ in nu ye te̍ tarutro̱kthebhi̍r vā su̱mnam ā̱vivā̍sān | stṛ̱ṇā̱nāso̍ ba̱rhiḥ pa̱styā̍va̱t tvotā̱ id i̍ndra̱ vāja̍m agman ||
english: Those great conquerors of yours, or those who have sought your favor with praises — they, strewing the sacrificial grass as in a homestead, protected by you, O Indra, have truly reached the prize.

sanskrit: u̱greṣv in nu śū̍ra mandasā̱nas trika̍drukeṣu pāhi̱ soma̍m indra | pra̱dodhu̍va̱c chmaśru̍ṣu prīṇā̱no yā̱hi hari̍bhyāṁ su̱tasya̍ pī̱tim ||
english: Among the mighty, O hero — rejoicing — drink the Soma at the three Kadru vessels, O Indra. Having caused your beards to tremble with delight, come with your two bays to drink of the pressed drink.

sanskrit: dhi̱ṣvā śava̍ḥ śūra̱ yena̍ vṛ̱tram a̱vābhi̍na̱d dānu̍m aurṇavā̱bham | apā̍vṛṇo̱r jyoti̱r āryā̍ya̱ ni sa̍vya̱taḥ sā̍di̱ dasyu̍r indra ||
english: Assume the might, O hero, with which you broke down Vṛtra, Dānu, and Aurṇavābha. You revealed the light for the Ārya; the Dasyu was made to sit on his left side, O Indra.

sanskrit: sane̍ma̱ ye ta̍ ū̱tibhi̱s tara̍nto̱ viśvā̱ḥ spṛdha̱ ārye̍ṇa̱ dasyū̍n | a̱smabhya̱ṁ tat tvā̱ṣṭraṁ vi̱śvarū̍pa̱m ara̍ndhayaḥ sā̱khyasya̍ tri̱tāya̍ ||
english: May we be of those who, with your help, crossing over, overcome all rivals and Dasyus for the Ārya. You have subjected to us for the friendship of Trita that Tvaṣṭra-born thing of all forms.

sanskrit: a̱sya su̍vā̱nasya̍ ma̱ndina̍s tri̱tasya̱ ny arbu̍daṁ vāvṛdhā̱no a̍staḥ | ava̍rtaya̱t sūryo̱ na ca̱kram bhi̱nad va̱lam indro̱ aṅgi̍rasvān ||
english: Growing great on the pressed, exhilarating drink of Trita, he has struck down the myriad serpents. Indra with the Aṅgirases has turned the sun like a wheel; he has cloven Vala.

sanskrit: nū̱naṁ sā te̱ prati̱ vara̍ṁ jari̱tre du̍hī̱yad i̍ndra̱ dakṣi̍ṇā ma̱ghonī̍ | śikṣā̍ sto̱tṛbhyo̱ māti̍ dha̱g bhago̍ no bṛ̱had va̍dema vi̱dathe̍ su̱vīrā̍ḥ ||
english: Now may that bountiful right hand of yours, O Indra, yield to your singer the choicest gift. Grant aid to the praisers; let our share not be consumed. May we speak great words at the assembly, possessed of heroes.

sanskrit: yo jā̱ta e̱va pra̍tha̱mo mana̍svān de̱vo de̱vān kratu̍nā pa̱ryabhū̍ṣat | yasya̱ śuṣmā̱d roda̍sī̱ abhya̍setāṁ nṛ̱mṇasya̍ ma̱hnā sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: He who, as soon as born, was the first thinker, the god who encompassed the gods with his power of will — from whose might the two world-halves trembled in fear at the greatness of his manly force — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yaḥ pṛ̍thi̱vīṁ vyatha̍mānā̱m adṛ̍ṁha̱d yaḥ parva̍tā̱n praku̍pitā̱m̐ ara̍mṇāt | yo a̱ntari̍kṣaṁ vima̱me varī̍yo̱ yo dyām asta̍bhnā̱t sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: He who made firm the trembling earth; he who stilled the mountains when they were enraged; he who measured out the atmosphere more widely; he who propped up the sky — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yo ha̱tvāhi̱m ari̍ṇāt sa̱pta sindhū̱n yo gā u̱dāja̍d apa̱dhā va̱lasya̍ | yo aśma̍nor a̱ntar a̱gniṁ ja̱jāna̍ sa̱ṁvṛk sa̱matsu̱ sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: He who, having slain the serpent, released the seven rivers; who drove out the cows having opened Vala's lair; who begot fire between the two stones — the victorious one in battles — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yene̱mā viśvā̱ cyava̍nā kṛ̱tāni̱ yo dāsa̱ṁ varṇa̱m adha̍ra̱ṁ guhāka̍ḥ | śva̱ghnīva̱ yo ji̍gī̱vām̐l la̱kṣam āda̍d a̱ryaḥ pu̱ṣṭāni̱ sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: By whom these all-moving things were made; who has placed the dark Dāsa-color below, hiding it; who, like a gambler winning, has taken up the mark and the Ārya's abundance — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yaṁ smā̍ pṛ̱cchanti̱ kuha̱ seti̍ gho̱ram u̱tem ā̍hu̱r naiṣo a̱stīty e̍nam | so a̱ryaḥ pu̱ṣṭīr vija̍ i̱vā mi̍nāti̱ śrad a̍smai dhatta̱ sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: Of whom they ask in awe "Where is he?" and they even say of him "He does not exist" — yet he diminishes the Ārya's riches like a dice-player's throw. Place faith in him — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yo ra̱dhrasya̍ codi̱tā yaḥ kṛ̱śasya̱ yo bra̱hmaṇo̱ nādha̍mānasya kī̱reḥ | yu̱ktagrā̍vṇo̱ yo̍ 'vi̱tā su̍śi̱praḥ su̱taso̍masya̱ sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: He who is the encourager of the feeble, of the emaciated; of the Brahman-singer calling out in distress; of the one whose pressing-stones are yoked — the fine-jawed protector of the pressed Soma — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yasyāśvā̍saḥ pra̱diśi̱ yasya̱ gāvo̱ yasya̱ grāmā̱ yasya̱ viśve̱ rathā̍saḥ | yaḥ sūrya̱ṁ ya u̱ṣasa̍ṁ ja̱jāna̱ yo a̱pāṁ ne̱tā sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: Whose are the horses in every direction, whose the cattle, whose the settlements, whose all the chariots; who begot the sun, who the dawn, who is the leader of the waters — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yaṁ kranda̍sī saṁya̱tī vi̱hvaye̍te̱ pare 'va̍ra u̱bhayā̍ a̱mitrā̍ḥ | sa̱mā̱naṁ ci̱d ratha̍m ātasthi̱vāṁsā̱ nānā̍ havete̱ sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: Whom the two opposing battle-cries invoke — the far and the near, both enemies — having mounted the same chariot, they call upon him separately — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yasmā̱n na ṛ̱te vi̱jaya̍nte̱ janā̍so̱ yaṁ yudhya̍mānā̱ ava̍se̱ hava̍nte | yo viśva̍sya prati̱māna̍m ba̱bhūva̱ yo a̍cyuta̱cyut sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: Without whom the peoples do not conquer; whom those who fight invoke for help; who has become the measure of all; who shakes the unshakable — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yaḥ śaśva̍to̱ mahy eno̱ dadhā̍nā̱n ama̍nyamānā̱ñ charvā̍ ja̱ghāna̍ | yaḥ śardha̍te̱ nānu̱dadā̍ti śṛ̱dhyāṁ yo dasyo̍r ha̱ntā sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: Who slew with his weapon those who were repeatedly committing great sin, those who thought nothing of it; who yields not one measure to the arrogant; who is the slayer of the Dasyu — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yaḥ śamba̍ra̱m parva̍teṣu kṣi̱yanta̍ṁ catvāri̱ṁśyāṁ śa̱rady a̱nvavi̍ndat | o̱jā̱yamā̍na̱ṁ yo ahi̍ṁ ja̱ghāna̱ dānu̱ṁ śayā̍na̱ṁ sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: Who found Śambara dwelling in the mountains in the fortieth autumn; who slew the serpent growing in strength, Dānu lying asleep — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yaḥ sa̱ptara̍śmir vṛṣa̱bhas tuvi̍ṣmān a̱vāsṛ̍ja̱t sarta̍ve sa̱pta sindhū̍n | yo rau̍hi̱ṇam asphu̍ra̱d vajra̍bāhu̱r dyām ā̱roha̍nta̱ṁ sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: He who, seven-rayed, the mighty bull, released the seven rivers to flow; who, thunderbolt-armed, kicked away Rauhinī as she was ascending to the sky — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: dyāvā̍ cid asmai pṛthi̱vī na̍mete̱ śuṣmā̍c cid asya̱ parva̍tā bhayante | yaḥ so̍ma̱pā ni̍ci̱to vajra̍bāhu̱r yo vajra̍hasta̱ḥ sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: Even heaven and earth bow down to him; even the mountains fear his might. He who drinks Soma, who is intent, whose arms hold the thunderbolt, who is thunderbolt-handed — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yaḥ su̱nvanta̱m ava̍ti̱ yaḥ paca̍nta̱ṁ yaḥ śaṁsa̍nta̱ṁ yaḥ śa̍śamā̱nam ū̱tī | yasya̱ brahma̱ vardha̍na̱ṁ yasya̱ somo̱ yasye̱daṁ rādha̱ḥ sa ja̍nāsa̱ indra̍ḥ ||
english: Who helps the presser, who helps the cooker, who helps the reciter, who helps the toiling one with his aid; whose growing power is prayer, whose is the Soma, whose is this bounty — he, O people, is Indra.

sanskrit: yaḥ su̍nva̱te paca̍te du̱dhra ā ci̱d vāja̱ṁ darda̍rṣi̱ sa kilā̍si sa̱tyaḥ ||va̱yaṁ ta̍ indra vi̱śvaha̍ pri̱yāsa̍ḥ su̱vīrā̍so vi̱datha̱m ā va̍dema ||
english: You truly shatter the prize even for the unwilling presser and cooker — yes, you are true. May we, always dear to you, O Indra, possessed of heroes, speak forth at the assembly.
